tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// drang srong loka tri pā la'i bsnyen mtshams kyi zhal gzigs skor bzhugs so//

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang lhag pa'i lha mchog drang srong chen po dri med la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rang gi 'khrul snang bstan gzung gi rim pa la/ rang lo bcu gcig gi steng shing mo sbrul gyi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes drug nas rtsis/ drang srong chen po dri med 'od zer gyi bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pa'i tshe/ zhag gnyis kyi thog sa rub mtshams der mi shin tu che ba khyim gang ba zhig byung*/ de'i phyi dgong nyi ma bzhud pa dang mnyam du/ me rdog po zhun si ri ri khol ba mang po las me stag phra mo khrom khrom byed pa/ me dung mang po phyogs phyogs su 'phro zhing*/ dri rag gzhob ching ching byung bas/ yid brtan la phab nas bskyed rim gsal ba dang*/ sngags la yang drag tu brtson par byas| srod thun gyi skabs su/ drang srong dri med 'od zer nyid khye'u gzugs can gzhon sha dang ldan pa/ sku mdog dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum dmul ba yid rab tu 'phrog pa ras dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba zhig yun ring bar mjal/ de nas nyal bar brtsam pa dang*/ mi dkar po lag gnyis na ral gri dang thod phor 'dzin pa zhig gis/ yid 'phrog pa'i 'cham sna tshogs mang po dal 'brel sna tshogs su/ yun shin tu ring ba byas pas sems khrid de gnyid log tu mi ster ba byung*/ tho rangs rmi lam du/ nga rang gi sngar rnyed pa'i chu 'go der/ nged rang ming sring chung ba tsho dang*/ gzhan yang mi ban skye mang po dang lhan cig skyo sangs la phyin| der khri zhig yod pa'i steng du/ bdag drang srong khros pa'i khro bo gar gyi nyams can khro zhing rngam pa zhig tu gyur pa la/ gzugs byad mi yin pa 'dra 'dra la// mgo dang rgyan gos 'dra mi 'dra mang pos/ gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag dang bskor ba mang du byed pa rmis/ zhag lnga'i thog tshes bcu'i nyin/ mkha' lam la mi ma yin gzugs mi sdug pa'i ltas du ma tshang ba/ ras sngon gyi zla dor gyon pa zhig rkang pa sprin sngon gyi khrod nas mi gsal ba zhig gis/

bdag la rngam rngam mang po byed cing 'gro ba/ de dang ma 'gyang bar gcer bu smug nag mgo med pa/ sgrog ldebs gnyis la mig yod pa/ kha brang mtshams na yod pa ltas ngan pa'i rtags dang ldan pa zhig yan lag bzhi so sor bsgrad nas/ 'jigs tshul du ma ston pa dang*/ bya nag mang po gshog 'dzings byed pa'i nang na/ ban de'i mgo la sha'i mchu yod pa mi pags kyi ang rag gyon pa zhig mig gro shig shig bdag la bskor zhing rgyun ring bar du lding ba rnams mthong*/ tshes bcu gcig gi dgong kha nyi grib chu la snyeg pa'i dus/ yid skyo dung nge ba zhig gi ngang nas drang srong dri med la gus pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ bsnyen sgrub la ched du 'bad pa'i mod la/ nyams snang lta bu zhig la zla bo su yang med pa/ spang ljongs shin tu sngo ba me tog du ma yod pa zhig tu/ bung ba mang po dir ri ri byed cing 'dug par snying brtse ba yang tshad dang bral ba byung zhing*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od sna lnga las grub pa'i 'od sgor phub tsam zhig 'dug pa la bltas pas/ de'i dkyil du o rgyan rin po che paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha byad can/ sku tshad mtho gang tsam la/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan rnams ma 'dres pa bris sku ltar gsal ba byis pa chung ngu'i sha nyams ldan pa zhig mjal bas/ 'di 'dra yang bdag mig 'khrul ba yin nam snyam/ mig gdang btsum mang du byas zhing*/ ched du bltas kyang sngar ltar gsal bar 'dug pas/ yid rab tu dga' nas 'di na ya mtshan shin tu che/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub zhu snyam/ tshig tu yang de ltar brjod nas/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par blangs nas/ rang la stim pa'i nyams snang la/ gnyid sad pa ltar byung*/ de nas bzung ste zhag kha yar mig lam du yang o rgyan rin po che de dang mi 'bral ba byung ngo*// yang nyi ma ngo yod de khar smin mtshams su khro bo zhe sdang rdo rje sku chung la dod pa/ khro zhing rngam pa/ yan lag thams cad kyang rags la sbom pa/

sku yi cha rnams las 'od zer sna tshogs dang*/ smin ma ag tshom ba spu'i khung bu sogs nas kyang*/ me stag 'phro ba zhig kyang mjal/ des bskyed rim gsal ba'i grogs kyang byung*/ yang thun mtshams gnyid kyi khog tshes bcu gnyis kyi nub/ rmi lam du rje btsun dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po dang mjal| thugs dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas/ bdag gi mgo la phyag gis byil byil dang*/ gces gces kyi rnam pa mang po mdzad byung bar/ bdag gi bsam pa la/ rje nyid gzhan don la dgongs pa yin rung*/ 'di ltar thugs dbang du 'du bar 'dug pa la snyam pa'i sems shin tu yus pa zhig byung bas/ sku pang du mgo bzhag nas mang du ngu zhing*/ rje nyid thugs dbang 'di ltar 'dus pa 'dug par/ lo shas mi bzhugs par mi kun de tsam rang sdug tu 'jug pa/ nged ming sring rnams kyang chung bas gsung chos bzhin yang 'ga' ma thos/ bsten yun yang thung zhus skad chen pos drag tu ngus pas/ spyan hur gyis gzigs pas khyod ci zer 'dod yin/ bsten rgyun dang chos thos de kha tsam yin mod/ da dung yang 'phral du phran bu byas chog nyer mkho gang rung chos rje sku mched bla ma rnam gnyis la zhus pas 'thus mod gsungs/ gzhan yang bdag brid pa'i bka' lung mang du gnang rjes gnyid sad pa dang*/ sngas kyang tshang ma mchi mas bangs 'dug cing*/ de'i phyi nyin nas rmi lam dran pa'i rkyen byas/ rkang lag 'dar zhing lus sbrid pa dang*/ skabs skabs su snying gzer byed cing*/ dbugs 'tshang zhing rgyab mdun yang shin tu na ba byung yang*/ mtshungs med pa phebs byung bar/ rmi lam gyis rkyen byas/ na tshul ni rna rus na nas zhu ma shes/ bdag rlung yin pa 'dra/ 'di bzhin na zhus pas/ zhal snga nas/ lhongs kyi rnam pa zhig yin 'dug pa/ ye shes sems dpa' de lte 'og tu sgom gsungs/ de bzhin bsgoms pas nad las grol ba dang*| khams shin tu nyog pa byung bas/

yang zhus pas/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa' snying khar sgom gsungs/ na tshul zhib pa rnams rjes su min pa 'bul ma spobs/ gdams ngag la yid ches pa dang*/ nyid la yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob/ yang tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ mdun bskyed bram ze de/ shin tu bgres pa'i nyams can sku mdog sngo skya smin ma dang ag tshom yang shin tu ring ba/ zhabs gnyis tsog pus bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis na shing gi 'khar ba dang*/ bgrang phreng bsnams pa zhig tu gyur nas/ spyan zim me 'dug pa yang yang mjal bas| bdag gis kyang gus pa'i yid kyis mos pa dang tshe rabs rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam phyin ci ma log par btab/ bcu drug gi dgong mo mun chu rub mtshams der/ du ba lta bu'i mdog kham long nge zhig gi dkyil du/ rdo rje nag po rtse khru gang tsam zhig gi sked pa dar dpyangs dmar pos brgyan pa zhig mthong*/ tshes bcu dgu'i phyi dro/ mi bsrun pa mgo bzhi yod pa/ skra gyen du bcings pa/ bongs thung la/ mdog sngo nag yan lag rags shing*/ dri mi zhim pa ching ching bro ba/ gzigs pags gis smad dkris pa zhig gis/ mig rnams so sor bgrad nas bdag la sdigs mo rang byed cing 'dug par/ bdag gis kyang lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ gnod byed kun 'dus pa'i byad mar bsam la/ gan rkyal du 'gyel bas lces brang bkab pa'i dkyil du gnam lcags kyi rdo rje btab pas skad kyang hrug sgra dang bcas pa byung ba'i snang ba la/ de nyid mi snang bar/ rje btsun dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs de nyid sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pa sngar las kyang zhal mdangs dkar ba zhig zhal 'dzum me bdag la gzigs shing*/ phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i mdun du/ mi bsrun pa de yang ban+de dar ma sha rtsa sngo ba zhig tu gyur nas/ gzan ngur ser snying rje ba zhig gyon 'gyod pa drag pos sems gdungs shing*/ gus pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ mgo gug dang bcas nas 'dug pa mjal bas/

mig gdang btsum med par dar cig lus 'dug sgyu ma lta bur song rjes/ bdag 'jigs pa las thugs brtse bas skyob pa 'di 'dra re dga' ste/ da lta dngos su bzhugs na ci ma rung snyam pa'i skyo ba tshad las 'das pa zhig byung rung*/ nyams snang du mjal ba'i dga' spro skye tshul/ mtshungs med dam pa bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du phul ba/ e ma la 'di ltar nyams snang la// dus da res mun chu rub mtshams la// 'dre mi bsrun gdong bzhi'i 'jigs tshul byung*// bdag lha yi nga rgyal brtan byas te/ gdon gnod byed kun 'dus byad ma yi// lce brang la bkab pa'i nṛ dag la// gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu yi// ra bsnun pa'i skad de hrug sgra byung*// mig lta stangs bgrad pa'i mkha' lam na// yab chos kyi rgyal po brtse ba can// sku gzi mdangs ldan pa 'dzum zhing bzhad// gzhi rten med mkha' la sems dkyil bzhugs// phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i mdun| |ban dar ma sngo nag gzan ser can// lus gus pas btsugs 'dug thal sbyar can// 'gyod drag pos nongs tshul ston pa mthong*// 'di bden nam 'khrul snang ci 'dra snyam// ha las drag cung zad tsam zhig lus// mig rig pa hur gyis nan bltas pas// rje mi mngon dbyings su 'ja' ltar yal// sems dga' zhing spro ba tshad las 'das// bdag bsten yun thung yang gces ma 'dor// dus da lta nga las dga' spro su// spro tshul gyi zhu yig thung tsam 'di// drin 'khor med skyong ba skyabs kyi mchog /rje maṅga'i mtshan can phyag tu 'bul// zhes kyang phul/ tshes nyi shu'i srod thun gyi gtor ma phul rjes la/ keng rus bongs tshad sor bzhi tsam la/ mig dang tshigs kha rnams dmar hung hung ba/ gzugs byad shin tu dod pa zhig gis/ bar snang la ya mtshan pa'i gar gyi rnam pa mang po byed cing 'dug pas sems khrid/ de 'dra ba mang po gcig las gcig thon pa ltar byas/

gzugs tshad kyang ma nges pa che ba ri dang*/ chung ba phra mo'i rdul phran gyi dpe ltar shin tu mang ba 'tshogs nas/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang tshang ma gang ste/ yun ring bar du lha yi rol mo dang sbyar ba'i gar gyi rnam grangs brjod bya'i yul las 'das pa dag /yun shin tu ring ba dag yid spro ba dang bcas pa byung*/ nyer gcig gi nyin/ tsha rjes su/ gshin rje'i khro chung byi ru ltar dmar zhing*/ khro rngam dang ldan pa/ skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas pa ral gri dang*/ g.yon khram shing*/ phyi nang med pa gsal ba'i ngos la/ srid pa gsum gyi bkod pa gsal bar 'char ba gdengs ba zhig /rngam drag me yi tsha tsha 'phro ba'i nang na glog ltar 'gyu zhing rgyu ba mthong nas 'phral du bdag gi snang ba la/ dben zhing nyams dga' la yid 'phrog pa'i gnas bzang po yin rgyu ba zhig na/ rgyab ri shin tu mtho ba/ rtse la kha ba dang na bun gyis rgyun du g.yogs pa/ sked pa man chad spang dang brag ri 'dres mar yod pa/ shug pa sogs shing rtsi ma tshang ba med pa'i khrod du/ gzugs mdzes pa'i ri dwags dang skad snyan bya tshogs du ma yod pa/ me tog dang sman sna tshogs kyi dris kyang yid spro nus pa/ rgyab ri che ba'i ngos na brag phug sgo gcig la phug che chung gnyis yod pa'i sgo nas rdo skas rgyang ya zhig yod pa'i rtsar/ chu 'bab pa'i skad khrog khrog zer ba nang du thos pa/ brag phug che ba'i nang du phye dang yo byad phran bu yod pa/ chung ba'i nang du nyal mal dang*/ thab chas rdor dril yo byad sogs yod pa/ ri de dang rgyud 'brel ba'i g.yon ngos nas/ brag ri ngang zom zom pa zhig 'dug pa de nas kyang*/ chu skya si re ba zhig 'bab pa'ang phug mdun gyi chu de dang 'dre ba/ dben zhing bag phebs pa der phal cher lus 'di rang yin pa 'dra ba la/ res 'ga' rgad po sna chen po yod pa sna rang gis kyang mthong ba/ sle bem chen po dung gi cha ru can zhig gyon yod pa 'dra ba byung*/

bdag byis pa chung ngu kha cher 'bug mi shes pa'i skabs su yang der bsdad pa'i snang ba mang du byung*/ gnas de nas g.yas ngos su mig rgyang gang na/ grong chen po rang zhig yod pa de la chu chen po gru gtong dgos pa zhig bskor nas 'bab/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang grong pa de nas yong ba'i snang ba kho na byung*/ de'i phyi dgong rmi lam yin pa 'dra zhig la/ a ma g.yang khug yin rgyu ba la/ chas rgyan de las bzang ba/ zhal rlangs dang na bza' la dri zhim po bro ba'i bud med rgan char/ lab lugs 'dug tshul sogs bzang po'i spyod tshul dang ldan pa zhig gis/ lug sha tsho la che ba'i lag pa zhig gtad/ snying la 'phrod pa'i kha ta mang po byas rjes/ da lam bcad rgya 'di bdun mtshams bcu mdzod/ bsnyen sgrub 'di mthar ma phyin gyi bar la mi che phra chung gsum su byung yang mdun du ma gtong zer nas/ mtshungs med par phul bas/ de a phyi yin 'dug pa/ da cha su byung yang ma thug na drags gsungs/ de nas zhag gnyis thog nas hor dpon karma g.yul rgyal dpon g.yog mang po zhig byung yang*/ nan chen pos thug dgos tshul zer yang ma thug /de nyin dros kha byis pa hor chas can mgo g.yu ril la/ ltag tshar ring mo yod pa gsum gyis gtsos/ gzhan pa byis pa thal skya shur shur ba mang po dang*/ the'u rang gi cha byad can mang po byung nas/ gcig gis sna la 'dzub mo tshugs tshugs byas/ gzhan yang ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan song*/ de nas srod la rlung chen po langs pa'i rkyen byas/ gnyid ye ma khug cing*/ brang rngul dang*/ 'jigs chum chum pa mang du byung bas/ da ci'i rnam rtog mdzub tshugs pa des rtags shig ston pa yin nam snyam pa'i bsam pa skyes ma thag tu/ mdun du gre bo mgo med pa/ gcer bu gzugs mi sdug pa shin tu che ba/ mig dpung ldebs su yod pa/ kha khrag chil chil ske mtshams su yod pa/ lus thams cad khrag 'brum gyis khengs pa/

lag mthil dang sor mo rnams nas kyang khrag rgyun lta bu 'bab pa zhig langs byung ba de dang mnyam du/ bdag gi rgyab mtshams med par mi sdug pa'i ltas dang ldan pa'i bud med dang*/ gre bo the'u rang sogs kyis bskor byung bar/ sde brgyad loka tri pā la'i sngags rgod gsum gyi mthar/ gzir mnan tshar gcod kyi dmigs pa dang*| nyi zla kha sbyor gyi thal mo brdabs pas/ thams cad sngangs shing sran phung la dbyug gus bsnun pa ltar song ngo*// bdun mtshams gsum pa'i mjug nyer drug gi dgong ja kha/ bdag khro bo'i bskyed rim gsal bar yod pa'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ sprin chen po 'khrigs pa ltar/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa sku che la yan lag rags pa lta ba'i chog dang bral ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma dmar ser du 'bar zhing*/ thod pa skam rlon rnams kyang che chung gi tshad brjod bya'i dpe dang bral ba/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i bcad mtshams dang kha nas khrag 'dzag cing mig thib thib byed pa sha stag sbrul rigs lnga so sor phrig phrig 'dar bas brgyan pa/ rus pa dang rin po che du ma'i rgyan gyis legs par spras pa/ zhabs gnyis gshibs nas dmar nag 'od kyi nang na bzhengs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba'i khrod du/ 'od sna lnga las grub pa'i rdo rjes brgyan pa zhig mjal/ phag gdong nag mo ral gri dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ skra kham ser gyis lus khebs pa zhig gar song du me'i char skar mda' ltar phra rags du ma 'bab pa yang mthong*/ nyer bdun gyi zhag skor der sngags chas gzugs shin tu ring ba nyi ma'i zer yang sgrib nus pa/ re nag gi phod chen dang zhwa nag gyon pa/ ral nag rgyab tu snyil ba gdong smug nag kha sna nas du ba lta bu'i rlangs pa 'tshub pa zhig yang yang rang gi mig lam du byung bas rkyen byas/ khams kyang nyog /mgo gting nas gzer zhing skyugs mer chil le ba byung*/ glo bur du snying gzer ldang zhing bsnyen sgrub g.yel 'dod pa byung*/

'di ci yin mtshungs med dam par zhus pas/ de drang srong rā hu la'i lhongs su 'dug pas/ shin tu gzab par gyis gsungs/ nyer brgyad kyi snga dro/ li khri lta bu'i 'od khyil li ba zhig gi nang du/ dpal he ru ka lhan skyes yab yum gar gyi nyams dang ldan pa zhig ma 'dres rgyan dang bcas te/ smin mtshams su skar mda' ltar hril gyi byung ba mjal bas/ sngar gyi rmugs pa sangs nas sems mal du gnas par gyur/ sngags la lhag tu 'dren 'dod che zhing bskyed rim la rang dbang 'dus pa byung*/ nyer dgu'i nyin gshin rje tshe bdag gi sgrub pa'i gser skyems kyi skabs/ mi'i lus la lug gi mgo yod pa zhig /bu mo skra kham si re ba mi pags kyi g.yang gzhi gos su klubs pa zhig gis zhon/ gzhan mi'i bu mo'i cha byad can gnyis dang gsum dpon g.yog gi tshul du 'gro ba dang*/ ban+de lag na dbyug tho bzung ba zhig gis khrims byed cing*/ gzhan mi ma yin mang po 'khrugs long long byed pa sogs/ byed tshul mi 'dra ba mang du mthong yang ma bris/ srod thun gtor bsngos kyi skabs su/ rje btsun rin chen phun tshogs sngags chas chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can zhig pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa'i mdun g.yas su drang srong dri med mngon rtogs dang mthun pa zhig /zhal de nyid rang la gzigs pa zhig kyang mjal/ de'i dgong mo nas bzung sngar gyi mi dkar gri thod 'dzin pa de yang yang dang yang du byung*/ gnam gang gi snga dro phyi 'bred gnyis kar/ dpal he ru ka yab yum 'jigs dus kyi gdan dang*/ gar dgu'i nyams ldan gsal bar mjal/ de nas bzung zhag kha yar la sdod bag phebs shing*/ bsnyen sgrub dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba byung*/ bdun mtshams bzhi pa'i khog /rta lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig gi nyin yang*/ he ru ka lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba ltar/

ma 'dres pa rten dang brten pa yun ring bar du mjal/ tshes de rang gi dgong kha/ bud med sha gos dar zab ljang khra'i thog gos dar dkar gyis stod ma bklubs pa/ me tog stong ldan dkar po'i do shal dang*/ dbu dang snyan yang brgyan pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing sil bur grol ba zhig /phyag g.yas kyis mda' dar dmar po zhig bsnams pa/ ya rab dal bu'i 'gros yin pa la/ zhabs sa la ma reg par 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pas/ bdag la chos rje ma yengs shig gsungs nas/ mda' dar yar la lding byed cing 'dug par/ ci yod bsam hur gyis bltas pas/ bstan pa'i bdag po sku btso ma'i gser ltar 'od ljib ljib yod pa la/ khri dang rgyab yol rnams kyang 'od dmar ser rang las grub pa/ gzi brjid 'od 'phro zhing*/ dpal du ma dang ldan pa sku shin tu che ba zhig mjal/ snang brnyan de nyid mi snang ba dang*/ yud tsam na ban+de zhig gi lus la bse khrab mgo la yang bse rmog /rkang la rgya lham gyon pa/ sked pa la ral rkyang btags pa zhig kyang nan tan chen pos bdag la bltas pas 'gro ba mthong*/ de ni phu gu gdong rang gi btsan yin par 'dug /thun mtshams lnga pa'i khog tshes brgyad kyi nyin gung*/ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ mthing nag sbrul mjug ljang khu rin po che du mas brgyan pa dang*/ dbu dgu phyag bzhi pa mda' gzhu dang ldan pa zhags pa dang chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan gdengs ba zhig dang*/ gza' bdud sku mdog smug nag dbu dgu phyag gnyis pa zhig /g.yas ka pā la tsit+tas gang ba sku la brten pa/ g.yon spu gri phyar ba/ nor bu du ma'i rgyan phreng can zhig dang gnyis gshibs mar nam mkha'i lam la yud kyis rgyu ba mthong*/ de'i dgong kha/ a tsa ra spro thung la bzhin ras dang lus la ba spu bzang po yod pa gnyis kyi sngon ma des/ mi'i brang kha phye ba'i nang du/ snying la rgyu mas dkris gsum bskor ba'i mtshams mtshams su/ mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/

lce rnams bzhag 'dug par/ so sor rlangs pa tshub tshub byed pa zhig khyer 'dug pa bdag gi mdun na bzhag /rting mas mda' gzhu lcags las byas pa zhig rgyab tu bzung*/ gnyis ka mdun du pus btsugs su bsdad nas/ rgyab ma des bdag la/ nged gnyis kyis sngar nas bzung da lta phan la zhabs tog kho na bsgrubs pa yin na'ang*/ zhabs drung rin po che nas sngar babs kyi gnang cha tsho lugs bzhin ma byung bas/ 'di thad khyed kyis zhib par zhu rogs mdzod zer zhing yus pa'i lab mang po byed 'dug par/ ngas kyang zhu rogs mi yong ba dang*/ khyed gnyis bden tshul mang po labs pas/ sngon ma des/ khyed rang la bcol na 'di tsam re zhu rogs mi byed/ mi la gsung dus ngo chen po rang zhig yod pa/ da zhal ma mang 'di gsol zer nas phyi 'gros kyis sgor don song*/ zhabs drung du zhus pas/ snga dgong de zhi drag gi mthong tshul du 'dug pas/ ngas zhwa lha khang du lo ltar gyi gsol kha krig chags shig gtong gi yod pas gtong yong gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin phebs/ de nub rmi lam du/ khang pa zhig gi nang na yol ba dang 'phan/ bla bre sogs bshams pa'i khri chen po zhig gi steng nas/ rje btsun dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po de nyid/ cha lugs gu ru rin po che dang mthun pa byin bag dang ldan pa zhig tu mdzad bzhugs/ sku zhogs su dkyil 'khor chen po rang zhig 'dug par/ mi mang phyag dang bskor ba byed cing*/ 'dzab sngar tshor ma myong ba zhig bgrang gin 'dug /gzhan ma khri chung ba mang po 'dug par/ nged rang gi zhal ngo sku mched rnams dang*/ gzhan ma'ang che btsun dang ldan pa mang po 'khod 'dug par/ rje btsun zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ de dgong snga ba nas dbang 'di byed bsam pa yin yang*/ da bar dbang rdzas rnams sgrig pa dang dkyil 'khor sgrub par 'gor ba yin gsungs/ de nas las 'bras rnams mi bslu ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ 'khor ba las yid dbyung zhing*/

skyi g.ya' ba mang po gsungs par/ der 'dug pa phal cher sngangs shing 'dar zhum zhum byed kyin 'dug */ dbu che rnams kyang ngo nag rog ge 'dug /bdag la nan gyis gzigs nas/ snga gong khyed rnams sus kyang 'di yi rjes gnang tsam ma gtogs ma thob 'dug */ bdag gis kyang ri bo kun 'dus su rkang gtad phyin nas/ drang srong dri med rang la zhus pa yin/ gzhan thob ma myong*/ 'di ni sde brgyad zil gnon loka tri pā la'i dbang chog zer ba yin/ lhag tu yang drang srong chen po dri med la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs rting*/ gsang sngags gsar rnying tshang ma'i yi dam kun gyi byin rlabs 'jug pa yin gsungs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs lag tu 'grim pa dang*/ dbang rdzas ma tshang ba med pa 'grims byung ba rmis/ bdun mtshams drug pa'i 'gor/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin gung*/ drang srong pas nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khengs pa byung*/ bcu gcig gi dgong kha nyi ma mdung gang tsam yod dus/ dge bsnyen sog ra'i sku 'khor 'grim pa sogs mang ba zhig mthong yang*/ dgos chung du 'dug pas ma bris/ bco lnga'i tsha rjes nyin mthong la yod pa'i nyams snang 'dra ba la/ gu ru rin po che gtso 'khor gsum la/ lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor nas/ tshogs 'khor zhig bskor rgyu'i grabs su 'dug pa/ yul gnas ngo mi shes shing thag ring zhig tu bzhugs pa yang mjal/ bdun mtshams bdun gyi nang*/ tshes bco brgyad kyi snga dro dpal he ru ka dkar po shel gyi gong bu ltar gsal ba dwangs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar gdengs shing*/ g.yon ka pā la nor bus gang ba sku la brten cing 'gying ba/ 'jigs dus kyi gdan la 'od zer dkar po 'khrugs pa'i nang na bzhengs pa dang*/ dgong kha khro mo mthing nag gcer bu gzig sham can/ gri gug gis thod khrag dron mo dkrug cing gsol ba/

ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'bar zhing*/ rang lus las skyes pa'i rlung dmar dang 'grogs nas 'gro ba zhig kyang mjal/ nyer lnga'i nyin drang srong gza' yi rigs kha dog sna tshogs pa sbrul mjug tshang ma sdebs gcig rang la mar gshibs nas yol ba btang ba ltar 'dug /gzhan zhag kha yar der mi min 'dre srin gyi rnam pa mang ba 'ga' byung yang*/ lha'i gsal snang mi 'dra/ 'dre'i mig mthong 'dra ba mang du byung bas ma smras so// zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum gyi mun chu rub mtshams der bar snang gi mkha' lam la/ rgya khri rkang pa phra la ring ba/ ma gzhi dmar 'jam/ rin po che sna lnga'i phras mdzes par byas pa'i steng*/ dar zab kyi 'bol bzhi brtsegs kyi dbus na/ rje btsun dam pa chos kyi rgyal po de nyid/ sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ chos gos gsum gyi na bza' mdzes par gsol ba/ chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can/ paṇa zhwa ngur smrig /'dab los sku sked mnan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i khri'i rkang pa bzhi nas/ byis pa chung ngu lha'i gos dang*/ rin po che'i do shal/ me tog dkar po'i thod bcings pa bzhis btegs pa/ gcig gis gdugs yu ba ring po phyi nas sprad pa zhig skor zhing*/ dpon slob tshang mas bdag la byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs shing*/ mkha' la bya lding ba ltar byon pa mthong bas/ har gyis langs nas 'gro ba brtsam pa dang*/ dran pa zin pa tsam du byung bas/ bdag kyang de bzhin 'gro ba zhig yin na ci ma rung snyam pa byung*/ bdun mtshams dgu pa'i khog |tshes lnga'i nyin/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma/ chibs gro sngon zhig la smad gong tshang ma'i ngos la/ dar lce sna tshogs pu ru ru byed cing*/ dril chung dang g.yer kha mang po si li li 'khrol ba zhig la bcibs/ me long mda' dar bsnams pa zhig /rngam stabs su byon pa mjal bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la 'di bzhin brel ba ci yin snyam pa byung ba de mkhyen nas/

ngas ram gyi phu nas 'gro/ ci myur yang yong*/ de skad chos rje la lobs gsungs/ mtshungs med par zhus pas/ sog po kha than la dmigs pa'i a phyi'i log bsad 'khor lo zhig btsugs yod pas/ de kha'i rtags su 'dug gsungs/ de nub rmi lam du khams gsum zil gnon yin zer rgyu'i gur zhig la/ phyi yol sum rim 'dug pa'i phyogs bzhir rgyal mtshan/ gur thog la gañji ra dang*/ nang du yol ba/ bla bre/ lha rten thang ka sogs rgyas pa bshams pa zhig tu/ rgya khyon dang mnyam pa'i khri mthon po zhig la/ bdag bsdad 'dug /sgrub chen zhig btsugs pa'i khul 'dug par/ mi ltos mi chung ba 'dus 'dug /mi smug po drag mdog can zhig 'dug pas/ de la bdag gis thams cad e 'dus byas pas/ tshang ma da ki nas 'dus byung lags/ da bka' dbang gnang bar zhu zer bar/ bdag rang gdan nas ma langs par/ der 'dus pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bshar nas/ bum pa'i dbang dang*/ dam tshig gi chu blud pa rmis/ tshes drug gi nam gung gi thun la nye ba na/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i dkyil du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtho gang tsam la/ rtsa ba'i zhal khro zhing rngam pa/ g.yas phag zhal phag gdong snum la nag pa/ rus pa dang thod pa skam rlon gyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ stag pags kyi sham thabs dang*/ sked mtshams nas dar dpyangs ljang khus spras pa zhig /spyan gsum dmar la 'khrugs pa bdag la gzigs shing*/ g.yas gri gug sdigs mdzub me 'bar ba nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon thod rlon khrag 'dzags pa'i skra nas thugs kar bkan te 'dzin pa/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dar sna lnga dang ḍā ma ru dang dril bus brgyan pa gru mor bzung ba zhig /gar stabs ling nge 'dug pa'i mdun g.yas su/ paṇ+ḍi ta phyag mnyam bzhag gi steng du/ nor bu nyi zlas mtshan pa bsnams pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mdun na/ zhags pa dmar po'i sne la sbrul mgos mtshan pa/ zhag sgor ris su bzhag pa dang*/ phag mo de'i mdun g.yon ngos su/

rnal 'byor pa smug nag rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ stag pags kyi sham thabs can zhig khro mig gyen du bgrad nas/ sdigs mdzub dang ka pā la 'dzin pa zhig bzhengs pa'i zhabs sner/ zhags pa kha dog lnga ldan gyi sne rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa dang*/ tho ba zhig dang ral gri zhig 'dug par/ keng rus shin tu dkar la bkrag pa/ mig nang du khrag zhag khyil khyil byed pa gnyis bskor zhing 'khrab pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha srin 'dra min gnam sa gang ba/ nyams dga' la/ dgod bro ba mang po mthong yang*/ col chung bar 'gro dogs kyis ma smros so// tshes brgyad kyi zhogs pa/ mi skya dkar po zhig gis/ po ti zhig sngon la khyer/ rjes nas grub chen he ru ka'i rgyan drug dang ras dkar gyi ang rag can/ rus pa'i rigs lnga gsol ba zhig /dal bus byung nas/ bdag gi mdun du slebs pa dang*/ mi dkar des po ti rnal 'byor par phul/ des bdag la 'dzum 'dzum dang*/ dgyes pa'i tshul gyis glegs bam de mdun du bzhag song*/ yang dum tsam zhig nas/ ma he'i mgo can gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ stag pags mi mgo'i do shal can ral pa dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba gnyis/ gcig gis gcig la blta zhing*/ 'grogs pa ltar byed cing*/ dbyibs gar gyi rnam pa 'dra ba zhig byed pa mthong*/ bdun mtshams bcu pa'i thog /tshes dgu'i dgong kha der/ sems dga' yal yal ba la skyid snang yod pa zhig byung ba dang*/ bag yangs kyi rnam pas rkang pa brkyangs shing rgyab bsnyes pa'i mdun na mar/ 'ja' dkar po zhig gi sne la/ bod rje chos kyi rgyal po'i tshul/ dbu la la thod ngang zom zom yod pa zhig mu men dang byi ru'i phreng ba gser gyi ga'u baiḍūr+ya'i mthong can sogs kyis mgul mdzes pa zhig khri'u shing la byams bzhugs mdzad pa'i pus steng na phyag sor gdub bus mdzes pa'i phra'i nang du bdag gi bzhin ras sogs gsal ba zhig yud kyis bab byung ba dang*/

bdag kyang rang dbang med par byis pas ma mthong ba ltar/ rings stabs su rkang pa bskums/ phyag la 'jus nas yod/ des kyang bdag la byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs shing*/ shin tu byams pa'i tshul gyis gsung byon par nye ba na/ phyi nas sgo rdung ba'i rkyen byas te mi snang bar gyur pa dang 'phang snang tshad las 'das pa byung*/ bcu'i nyin/ bdag gi pus steng du g.yang ṭi'i mdog 'dra ba zhig la/ zur brgyad logs brgyad can brkyang khru gang ba zhig gi nang du gzugs brnyan gyi rigs dang*/ lha mi'i gzugs dang yul dang mkhar ma tshang ba med pa zhig 'dug par/ sems yengs drags pas sa la phab nas rgyun ring bsdad par brtson 'grus kyis yar mdzog mdzog mdzod zer nas 'gyogs zhig btang byung bas bor shor/ yang rgyang tsam zhig nas drang srong rgas po bon zhwa gyon pa lag na ra phor dang*/ chu shing gi 'khar ba 'dzin pa zhig mthong*/ nyin gung gnyid la thum tsam song 'dug pa gnyid sad pa'i mdun du/ drang srong dri med 'od gsal spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso'i bzhugs lugs mdzad pa zhig la/ lha'i rgyan gos yod pa'i byis pa gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas mtha' brten pa mjal| nyi ma gung yol tsam der/ nam mkha'i mthongs ya tshad cig na tshig 'bru cher mi gsal ba'i skad snyan po rang zhig yang yang byung bar nyan zhing bltas pas/ bu mo lo lnga lon pa tsam gsum gyis rgyal mtshan gnyis dang gdugs gcig khyer/ nor bu'i rigs mang po skar tshogs ltar 'khrugs pa'i khrod na/ rdo rje dril bu nag po rwa log shin tu che ba re 'dug pa dang yig 'bru'i rigs kyang mang ba 'dug /tshes gcig gi srod la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ gtso 'khor gsum la lha srin gyi dmag tshogs dang*/ mgo brnyan rigs mi 'dra ba mang pos bskor nas zing long long 'dug pa dang*/ bya khyi ce spyang sogs kyis bskor 'dug pa tshang ma mjug tu mgon po rang la thim pa dang de nyid kyang je phrar mi snang bar gyur to// bcu gsum gyi nyi dros der/

dbang gi mkha' 'gro chibs dmar zag cig bcibs nas mda' dar me long gdengs shing rgyug pa/ pad+ma dmar po stong ldan chen po zhig gi steng du/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sku chas rgyan skor sogs yongs grags yin pa las/ bzhengs te byin gyis rlob pa'i phyag rgya can zhig mjal/ bcu bzhi'i dgong kha der| glang chen gyi steng du drang srong khros pa'i khro bo bzhugs pa la/ lha klu'i rigs mang pos bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad sogs mchod pa'i rigs mang pos mchod pa dang*/ 'dre srin gyi rigs mang pos sngangs pa ltar byed cing*/ 'bogs shing brgyal ba yang mang po 'dug pa mthong*/ bdun mtshams bcu thems pas/ tshes bco lnga'i nub rmi lam 'dra ba zhig la/ gzugs mi rang la mgo dgu bya rog mchu can dang bcu yod pa zhig yang dang yang du byung ba dang*/ khams shin tu 'khrugs pa zhig byung bas/ bdag lha'i drang srong khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ nam mkha' lcags kyi tho ba me rab tu 'bar ba zhig gis brgyabs pas/ thal phung la rdo rgyab pa bzhin kham long nge song ba zhig byung ba sogs mtshams mal de'i ring*/ lha bla ma mjal ba dang*/ phyag mtshan yig sna'i rigs mang du byung ba/ 'dre srin gdug rtsub can gyi cho 'phrul dang gzugs rig pa/ lhongs sogs kyi byung tshul bris pas zin pa ma mchis shing dgos pa yang med par go// 'di dag kyang 'phral du a ma g.yang khug gis thugs dam smar ba byung las che gsungs par/ shog tshal phul ba phyogs gcig tu nyams mtshar du bsgrigs pa lags pas/ bla ma yi dam lhag pa'i lha dang drang srong chen po dri med drung du bzod par gsol// //maṅga laṃ//
